dict.Redactare: la salvare, textul de sub dre: Redaction: on save, the text under the rectangles is removed permanently and the rest of the page stays text (the page becomes an image only when there are pictures or drawings under an area).
dict.Textul vechi se scoate de tot din fișier: The old text is removed from the file completely (it can no longer be copied) and the rest of the page stays text. Unchecked, the old text is only covered with white.
dict.Straturile ascunse (cele oprite la desch: Hidden layers (those turned off on opening) and everything drawn on them
dict.Textul ascuns: invizibil, alb pe fundal: Hidden text: invisible, white on a white background, transparent, too small to see or in hidden comments (text over pictures, as in scanned documents, stays)
